name: Camp Urbie at Urban Air Adventure Park – Bellingham, MA
operator_name: Urban Air Adventure Park (an Unleashed Brands company)
description_short: An indoor day camp at the Urban Air trampoline and adventure park in Bellingham, offered as a full day or a half day (morning or afternoon) during school breaks. It mixes open play, guided games and competitions, and a version with hands-on STEAM activities led by Snapology instructors.
activities: STEAM activities led by Snapology instructors
refund_policy_summary: No refunds or exchanges. No credit for missed days. The Snapology Adventure Camp cannot be transferred. Payment is charged to the credit card entered when booking.

warnings: The page has no dates, season year or prices. It may be a year-round template page for this location, so check upcoming dates and prices with the park.

The page contradicts itself on meals. It lists 'Healthy snacks and balanced lunches' as included, but also says: 'We'll provide snacks and lunch on Wednesday and Friday but if your child is attending the full-day camp, you'll want to send them with a lunch for the other days.' It also says: 'Camp lunch and snack menu varies by park.'

The page is the camp operator's own material, but it is a national chain's location page. Most of the text is shared company copy, and it says the Snapology schedule is 'subject to change per park location.'
Endless Play Memberships do not include the Snapology camp.
Strict policy: no refunds, no exchanges and no credit for missed days.
